description: Phase 1: North region moves from Beacon to Meridian. Crestline Services takes all Meridian contacts under hypercare staffing.
expected_signature: Meridian contacts start; voice AHT vs the Beacon baseline is the first thing to check.

description: Chat bot switched OFF for the Halcyon book on Meridian (client contract clause: human-first). The benchmark book that runs 0.20 contacts per transaction has the bot ON.
expected_signature: No bot deflection; contacts per transaction stays near the Beacon regional level (~0.9), not 0.2.

description: Larkspur home team (10) in classroom training for Meridian; no live contacts.
expected_signature: Home team hours appear as training, productive 0.

description: Phase 2: East region moves to Meridian. Migrated population roughly doubles; Crestline held at 20 heads per the plan of record.
expected_signature: Contacts step up overnight (~1.9×); transactions do not.

description: Autumn travel season: whole-book transactions climb about 40% over four weeks after phase 2, plateau, then ease from day 100.
expected_signature: Transactions rise in every region including West (still on Beacon), so it is not a migration effect.

description: Larkspur home team nesting: takes live contacts at ~40% productivity with a supervisor; AHT starts at ~1.5× the Beacon baseline.
expected_signature: Home-team handled volume small; their AHT high but falling.

description: Crestline pulls six scheduled agents into a Meridian release training on both days; schedules unchanged, productive hours down ~30%.
expected_signature: SL, ASA and abandons collapse for two days with no change in transactions; offered rises only through same-day retries. Looks like demand; is supply.

description: Meridian platform outage (~4 h): chat sessions dropped, customers retry and call. Transactions unaffected.
expected_signature: Contacts spike (chat ×1.5, voice ×1.6), abandons very high, transactions flat.

description: Larkspur home team live (10 heads, ~7 scheduled per day). Learning curve: AHT from ~1.5× to ~1.05× of the Beacon baseline over eight weeks.
expected_signature: Blended AHT starts to fall while Crestline AHT does not.

description: Reactive surge add: Crestline +8 heads approved after the service break; arrive at Crestline's Meridian AHT (no curve).
expected_signature: Capacity step; SL recovers over ~3 weeks as the voice overflow unwinds. Confounded with the home team curve.

description: Severe weather in East: flight cancellations and rebooking. Transactions ×1.5–1.7 and contacts per transaction ×1.25 in East for three days, tail on day 83.
expected_signature: Transactions AND contacts spike together, East only; voice-skewed.

description: Phase 3 planned: West region (85% of transactions) to Meridian. Not live in this window.
expected_signature: None in the window; sizing is the open planning question.
